params.2184:
A lunatic chef that was once renowned for his culinary creations in Lumbridge Castle. His insane drive for domination soon came to light and he was imprisoned. Having broken free, he needs to be stopped before he carves someone up with that vicious looking meat cleaver he carries.

Quest: Recipe for Disaster

Combat: This twisted chef will attack with magic. Not so strong without his minions to protect him now!
params.2102: No more meals for you, fool
